Hi team,

Standard landing page alert policy:

Post alerts to #website-alerts on Slack.

Thanks,
Web Ops"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_vp_alert", "thread_id": "thread_vp_alert", "from_": "vp-marketing@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Updated CVR Alert Threshold", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-22T14:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_vp_alert
来源：vp-marketing@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-22T14:00:00Z
主题：Updated CVR Alert Threshold
Hi,

Going forward, only alert on pages with CVR below 3%. We've been getting too many false positives on pages that are actually performing adequately. This supersedes the standard Web Ops alert policy.

Thanks,
VP Marketing"}
